asset_name: John Hunter Health and Innovation Precinct
site_strategy: reinforce existing John Hunter site as tertiary referral and innovation precinct
future_expansion_signal: new acute building designed for projected ED demand >95000/year; tertiary role for Hunter and northern NSW
veca_interpretation: Major tertiary-health gravity is now strongly locked into Newcastle; future VECA options should treat this as inherited regional capital rather than movable renewal.

site_strategy: consolidate complex acute services on existing Albury campus
future_expansion_signal: master plan reserves expansion zones north and west for infrastructure/development/partnership opportunities over coming decades
veca_interpretation: A key example of a once-flexible cross-border hospital decision becoming site-locked while still preserving long-term campus expansion optionality.
source_note: NSW Health / Health Infrastructure master plan

site_strategy: future Wodonga campus role to shift as acute services consolidate in Albury
future_expansion_signal: planning explicitly considers transformation toward non-emergency care hub
veca_interpretation: Shows that even after a major site choice is fixed, service functions across a twin-city system can remain reallocatable.

site_strategy: retain Wagga as regional hospital hub
future_expansion_signal: new 2026 short-stay surgery service expands function without major new campus relocation
veca_interpretation: Wagga's health-hub inheritance is substantial and mostly sunk; future service additions are more flexible than core site location.
source_note: NSW Health regional project references and Aug 2026 service expansion

site_strategy: multi-stage expansion of existing Traralgon West campus
future_expansion_signal: state describes project as part of a broader master plan for Gippsland health services
veca_interpretation: Latrobe has accumulated sequential health capital and regional capability; future investment should be tested as reinforcement of a Gippsland growth pole.

site_strategy: relocate major services to Baillie Henderson campus and create broader health/knowledge precinct
future_expansion_signal: large new campus designed as long-life regional anchor
veca_interpretation: Demonstrates deliberate relocation before site lock-in and therefore the type of decision VECA needs to identify earlier in other regions.
